scene: The gleaming gold sleeve triggers hidden transit doors across the vault floor.
picture: Side-scrolling view of a wide vault chamber. At far left stands a glowing yellow night tram. To the left, the dark-haired boy in glasses and denim jacket clutches a gold record sleeve. In the centre, an open service elevator awaits. At far right, a wooden rowing boat floats in an indoor canal.
